description: This file implements a manager class 'CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl' responsible for storing, retrieving, and removing product image files within a CMS system, using Infinispan as the caching layer. It manages product images, supports different image sizes, and interacts with cache nodes structured by merchant and product identifiers.

classes.name: CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: A singleton class that manages product images stored in an Infinispan cache, providing methods to add, retrieve, and remove images, supporting multiple sizes and content types.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, typically during servlet undeployment.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the manager.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the cache, organizing by merchant, product SKU, and image size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product image from the cache given product details.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Fetches all images for a given product or merchant store.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific product image from cache.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Internal helper method to retrieve cache nodes by path, creating the node if it doesn't exist.
